posts.body:
I don't know if any posts like this already exist, but is there a way to change just the design of the base RPG Maker MV menus?
I have some references below, but basically is there any way to change just the outline / boxes for the menus, while keeping the same general design?

you can change the windowskin by making edits to the window.png file inside img/system
